endorsements.name: Mike Shema
endorsements.label: Dissecting CSRF Attacks & Countermeasures
endorsements.description: Cross Site Request Forgery (CSRF) remains a significant threat to web apps and user data. Current countermeasures like request nonces can be cumbersome to deploy correctly and difficult to apply to a site retroactively. Detecting these vulns with automated tools can be equally difficult to do accurately.
endorsements.subtitle: Black Hat Usa 2013
